title: NIA opens 6 solar-powered irrigation sites in Leyte amid El Niño

blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — The National Irrigation Administration (NIA) in Eastern Visayas has inaugurated six solar-powered irrigation facilities in Leyte to strengthen water supply to farmlands and help farmers prepare for the possible effects of the looming Super El Niño.
